_readme: Copy this file to trends.json to enable external market context in answers. Every entry MUST include observation, source_name, and retrieved_at — unsourced entries are silently dropped. Entries are curated: put only approved, citable market observations here (industry reports, association bulletins, approved APIs).

entries.observation: EXAMPLE — replace with an approved, citable observation, e.g. 'Lightweight daily-wear gold jewellery demand rising in urban markets'
entries.source_name: EXAMPLE — e.g. World Gold Council report / approved market feed

entries.observation: EXAMPLE — e.g. '24K gold trading near Rs. X per 10g'
